cleaning_step: Reviews collected from the Steam API (Apex Legends, 5 languages)
Keep only the window all five languages cover
reason: The collector pulls newest first and stops at a cap, so each language reaches back a different distance. Comparing raw data compares different time periods. Window: 2024-07-20 to 2026-09-21.

cleaning_step: Exclude the review-bombing months (July to September 2024)
reason: A protest in July 2024 spiked volume and collapsed the score in every language. It was faking a regional gap (Simplified script gap 20.8 pts with it, 4.1 without).

unit: negative reviews matching the connection topic
reason: A sampled review said the game always disconnects using 斷線, a term the keyword list missed, so the connection theme was undercounted. Rows here are matched reviews, not rows dropped.
